text:
marco: Opening a focused docs PR to consolidate the Starter Run quickstart. Scope: standardize auth examples, add a single-line first-deploy, reconcile curl vs SDK parity, and fix a couple of 404/redirecting links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/844
aya: love this. for the deploy example can we give a one-liner docker run that sets the env and starts the sample (pinned tag)? newbies copy that directly.
sylvia: also include a short migration note: OLD var REDWOOD_TOKEN -> canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY, and mention the CI secret name (REDWOOD_SECRET) if teams use that. keep it brief.
marco: plan: curl minimal (one line), JS async snippet (6 lines), Python minimal (2 lines), migration note, and a Troubleshooting mini-checklist. I'll replace stale /getting-started/local link with /deploy/local-run.
docs-bot: preview site created: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/844 (status: building) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
aya: small nit: prefer `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` on unix examples, not `set`. and use fenced ```bash blocks for terminal snippets for readability.
marco: updated to `export` and switched to fenced ```bash blocks. added pinned image `redwood/starter-run:0.7.3` in the docker example and a note about pinning for Dedicated/private installs.
sylvia: add a Troubleshooting bullet for 401s (check token, scope, KMS config) and for 502s (model mismatch or incompatible quantization). maybe a 3-item checklist.
marco: added Troubleshooting checklist and a tiny health check line: ```bash
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health
# expected: {"status":"ok"}
```
preview-bot: preview redeployed for commit sha: e4b7f2 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
aya: quick scan looks good. one more tiny ask: in the JS snippet show async/await `client.generate(...)` pattern so it matches the SDK docs folks search for.
marco: swapped the JS snippet to async/await (kept it under 8 lines). squashed WIP commits and updated PR description listing: auth var rename, pinned image, link fixes, migration note, troubleshooting, expected output. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/844 
ci-bot: lint: passed; link-check: auto-fixed 1 redirect in commit (sha: e4b7f2) :white_check_mark:
sylvia: approving now. tiny editorial nit handled.
marco: merged to main at 3800000320 1f4d40 389 thanks team!
